test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

He has been working (1) / as a poet (2) / since five years (3) / in the village (4).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the preposition "**since**" before the phrase "**five years**."
 
• The preposition "**for**" is used to indicate a period or duration of time (e.g., for two months, for five years).
 
• Conversely, "**since**" is used to indicate a specific starting point in time (e.g., since 2018, since Monday).
 
• Because "five years" is a duration, the correct phrase should be "**for five years**," ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He has been working as a poet **for five** years in the village."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "He has been working" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and appropriately uses the present perfect continuous tense.
 
• **2: "as a poet"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and functions perfectly as a prepositional phrase describing his role.
 
• **4: "in the village."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and correctly uses the preposition "in" to specify the location.
